en: Theragāthā 2.17 Dukanipāta, Second Chapter I am one who has transcended all bonds; I am one who has crossed over the flood. I have reached the further shore of existence; I am a sage who has attained peace.
The Verses of the Elder Tissa:
“One who has shaved his head and is clad in the outer robe incurs many enemies.”
